summary: Rectangular aluminum block mount with one end rounded and a chamfered corner. A through hole runs across the thickness near the rounded end. A second hole enters the opposite square end face along the long axis.

mountingSurfaces.description: Large flat face (16 x 30) containing the hole near the rounded end; the through hole exits the opposite face.
Square end face containing the second hole, perpendicular to the first.

notes: No dimensions are given in the listing, so all sizes are assumptions. I assumed a 16 mm width and thickness from the goBILDA 8 mm grid. The 30 mm length comes from the face-on view, where the aspect ratio is about 1.85:1, so it may really be 32 mm. The 8 mm hole diameter is estimated from the visible bore and may be the thread opening rather than the minor diameter. Hole positions are read from the images; the hole near the rounded end is about 8 mm from that end. The listing text does not say whether the end-face hole is blind, so it is recorded as non-through. Thread details, chamfer size and corner radius are not modeled.
